name: kukufm-dramapulse-studio
description: Interactive Vertical Drama Promo Finder Studio for Kuku FM AI Generalist Assignment

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let u=req.url.split('?')[0];let f=u==='/'?'index.html':u.replace(/^\//,'');f=path.resolve(f);if(!fs.existsSync(f)||fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()){f=path.resolve('index.html');}let mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'application/javascript','jpg':'image/jpeg','png':'image/png','json':'application/json'}[f.split('.').pop()]||'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('DramaPulse Studio running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Kuku FM AI Candidate
